title: Predictable pseudo-random generator used (c)
description: The code draws values from rand. The C library generator is a shared, deterministic sequence seeded from the clock, so two processes started together produce the same numbers and an observer can predict the next ones. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks what the value protects.
remediation: Use the operating system generator for anything security-relevant, for example getrandom or arc4random_buf.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the generator regardless of what the value is used for.
